cases.note: an astral character is one code point and two UTF-16 code units. Found by tools/workers-diff.mjs: a worker that iterates code units and then asks .NET for a code point by code unit throws on this input instead of normalizing it, while five other implementations pass it through unchanged.

astral code points are outside both tables: the lowercase table covers U+0000-U+024F, and section 2 says what the tables do not mention passes through unchanged, so U+1D400 stays U+1D400 and the real Deseret case pair U+10400/U+10428 is not folded. Both are outside the BMP, where a per-code-unit table lookup cannot see them
